definitions.explanation: a person of outstanding skill and achievement in an artistic or creative field, especially one with a long and distinguished career

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巨匠|きょしょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: He is called a master of cinema.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巨匠|きょしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This work was painted by a great master of Japanese painting.

examples.japanese: {二十世紀|にじっせいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巨匠|きょしょう}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦なお→なお：00305_nao⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The great masters of twentieth-century music still influence many people today.

notes:
A highly respectful title used for the most accomplished figures in creative or artistic fields. Typically refers to someone with decades of achievement and wide recognition, not simply anyone who is skilled.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巨匠|きょしょう}: master filmmaker
- ⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巨匠|きょしょう}: literary master
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巨匠|きょしょう}: master architect
- {巨匠|きょしょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called a master
- {巨匠|きょしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: a master's work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大家|たいか}: authority, master — broader, can include scholars and experts, not limited to arts
- {名匠|めいしょう}: master craftsman — emphasizes skill in craft or technique
- ⟦マエストロ→マエストロ：30012_maesutoro⟧: maestro — loanword, mainly used for conductors or musicians
- ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧: genius — emphasizes innate talent rather than career achievement

ETYMOLOGY:
{巨|きょ} (giant, great) + {匠|しょう} (craftsman, artisan). Literally "great craftsman."
